memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks with a stick, reports mild morning stiffness in hands.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait slow but steady; TUG 13 seconds (raised fall risk); advise leg strengthening exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 4 regular; polypharmacy not reached.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active and walk to the temple weekly."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 28 mm/hr (0-20); CRP 8 mg/L (<5); RF positive 45 IU/ml (<14); anti-CCP 68 U/ml (<20); LFT: ALT 30 U/L (7-56), AST 26 U/L (10-40), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dl (0.2-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate 10 mg once weekly; folic acid 5 mg once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone 5 mg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages ADLs with occasional knee pain, uses walking aid for longer distances.
cognition: No change; Mini-Cog not repeated this visit.
falls: One fall at home 3 months ago (minor bruise); gait uneven; TUG 14 seconds (raised fall risk); advise balance training and home hazard review.
medicines: 4 regular; polypharmacy not reached.
mood: Persistent low mood, reports poor sleep.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I wish to walk without pain to the market twice a week."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 22 mm/hr (0-20); CRP 6 mg/L (<5); LFT: ALT 38 U/L (7-56), AST 30 U/L (10-40).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate increased to 15 mg once weekly; folic acid 5 mg once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone 5 mg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Improved mobility, walks unaided for short distances, reports less joint swelling.
cognition: No change; Mini-Cog not repeated.
falls: No falls in last 6 months; gait steady; TUG 12 seconds (borderline raised fall risk); continue exercises and check footwear.
medicines: 4 regular; polypharmacy not reached.
mood: Mood improved, denies depressive symptoms.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to attend my grandson's school event without difficulty."

memories.text: ESR 18 mm/hr (0-20); CRP 4 mg/L (<5); RF 30 IU/ml (<14); anti-CCP 45 U/ml (<20).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate 15 mg once weekly; folic acid 5 mg once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone tapered to 2.5 mg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports increased hand pain and stiffness after festive season; uses warm packs.
cognition: Mini-Cog not due yet.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait mildly antalgic; TUG 13 seconds (raised fall risk); advise strengthening and proper shoes.
medicines: 4 regular; polypharmacy not reached.
mood: Reports frustration with pain, occasional tearfulness.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I hope to reduce pain enough to drive short distances again."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 26 mm/hr (0-20); CRP 9 mg/L (<5); LFT: ALT 55 U/L (7-56) mild rise, AST 48 U/L (10-40), bilirubin normal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate stopped; folic acid 5 mg once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone 5 mg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports better hand tolerance, able to grip steering wheel briefly; uses assistive device for longer walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (positive screen); plan for detailed neuropsych assessment.
falls: One fall outside home 2 months ago (no injury); gait slow; TUG 15 seconds (raised fall risk); refer to physiotherapy for balance.
medicines: 3 regular; polypharmacy not reached.
mood: Reports occasional sadness, denies hopelessness.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I wish to drive to the clinic on my own again."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate restarted at 7.5 mg once weekly; folic acid 5 mg once weekly; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone 5 mg OD.

memories.text:
